artifacts.summary: 7-phase plan adopting Resolution 1 (rehome the gates): corrects all three inherit-the-full-tool-set claims and settles every optional frontmatter row, drops the isolation row with its probes and both of its mirrors, relocates /meta's interview into skill-meta's own pre-delegation stages, strips the self-instructing AskUserQuestion language from 23 agent files, adds a capped fork prompt-scoping addendum to fork-patterns.md, lands a structural fixture under core/scripts/tests/, and narrows file_scope to 33 explicit paths.

memory_candidates.content: When a plan corrects a documented behavioural claim, enumerate the claim's CARRIERS by grep before sizing the phase -- a doc row is rarely the only copy. Measured instance: correcting agent-frontmatter-standard.md's tool-inheritance claim turned up a third occurrence in docs/templates/agent-template.md (so every agent authored from the template would re-seed the defect), and dropping its `isolation` row turned up two mirrors: a hardcoded SUPPORTED_KEYS entry in scripts/lint/lint-agent-contracts.sh (whose own comment claims to mirror that very table) and the template's field-name pointer list. A research report that measures the defect is not the same as an inventory of everything that repeats it. The cheap probes: `grep -rn '<claim phrasing variants>' --include='*.md'` for prose copies, and `grep -rln '"<field>"' scripts/ hooks/` for code mirrors whose comments cite the doc. Skipping this leaves the lint and the doc asserting opposite things after an otherwise-correct edit.
